$about: Per-key placeholder registry GENERATED from commerce-source-en.json (same placeholder name may have different semantics under different keys — the key-scoped meaning here is authoritative). Translators must keep placeholder names EXACTLY as-is. Regenerate/verify via scripts/i18n/check-commerce-i18n.mjs --write-registry.

cart.items.count: number of line items in the cart (drives the plural branch)

cart.removeItemAria.product: product name of the cart line from Saleor

cart.variantAttribute.name: attribute name from Saleor backend data (e.g. "Size")
cart.variantAttribute.value: attribute value name from Saleor backend data (e.g. "XL")

cart.variantLabel.variant: variant name from Saleor backend data

checkout.addressForm.fieldRequired.field: The localized address-field label, e.g. 'Mesto' / 'PSČ' (already translated via the address field label keys)

checkout.confirmation.emailNoticeWithAdd.confirmationEmail: customer e-mail address the order confirmation will be sent to (order.userEmail; never empty — the Generic variant renders otherwise)

checkout.confirmation.orderNumberLine.orderNumber: Saleor order number (e.g. 1023); in the dormant demo confirmation step a DEMO-XXXXXX code

checkout.contactSection.resetLinkSent.email: the email address the customer typed into the sign-in form

checkout.payment.freeOrderBody.total: Formatted order total with currency, e.g. 0,00 €

checkout.payment.loadingGateway.gateway: Payment gateway display name, e.g. Stripe

checkout.payment.priceChangedBody.previousTotal: Formatted previous order total including currency symbol (getFormattedMoney)
checkout.payment.priceChangedBody.newTotal: Formatted new order total including currency symbol (getFormattedMoney)

checkout.shipping.deliveryEstimate.max: method.maximumDeliveryDays (number); also drives the plural branch

checkout.shipping.noMethodsForCountry.countryName: Localized country name of the shipping address (Intl.DisplayNames via localizeCountryName, threaded with the market locale), always rendered inside parentheses — grammatically inert, no inflection needed. When unresolvable the code renders checkout.shipping.noMethodsForCountryGeneric instead.

checkout.steps.progress.stepCount: total number of visible checkout steps (2 or 3)

email.accountChangeEmailConfirm.intro.firstName: customer first name from the Notify payload (user.first_name); the *Generic variant renders when it is missing

email.accountChangeEmailRequest.intro.firstName: customer first name from the Notify payload (user.first_name); the *Generic variant renders when it is missing

email.accountConfirmation.intro.firstName: customer first name from the Notify payload (user.first_name); the *Generic variant renders when it is missing
